label: Bible Study
prompt: The Jews had light, and _____, and joy, and honour.
verse: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
note: The turnaround after Haman's plot fails — light, gladness, joy, and honour, in four quick words.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He raiseth up the poor out of the _____, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD'S, and he hath set the world upon them.
verse: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD'S, and he hath set the world upon them.
note: Hannah's song: God lifts the poor out of the dust and seats them among princes — a total turnaround.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared _____ and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
verse: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
note: Ten days of vegetables and water, and Daniel's crew looked fairer and healthier than everyone eating the king's food.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
verse: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
note: Corinth had been auditing Paul's credentials; he turns the tables — check your own faith first.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And as it is _____ unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verse: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
note: One life, one death, then judgment — and verse 28 adds the good news: Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many.
